info.title: Unitfield Apps API
info.description: Unitfield installed-app runtime API for websites, apps, and integrations.

post.summary: Queue a reviewed rental availability action
post.description: App-only runtime operation. Provide the current installation's client-credentials token; 'X-Tenant-Id' is not required. The extension must declare rental.availability.check.v1. Only the exact reviewed request and input fields are accepted; duplicate fields, arbitrary input JSON and internal IDs are rejected. The idempotency key replays only the identical action, input and grant generation. The response is queued work, and its result is available only while that grant remains current.

get.description: App-only runtime operation. Provide a client-credentials token for the resolved app installation; 'X-Tenant-Id' is not required.

post.summary: Create lease Checkout Session for Payment Element
post.description: Creates a Checkout Session with ui_mode=elements for a lease payment. Initialize CheckoutElementsProvider with the returned clientSecret and stripeAccountId, then call checkout.confirm() to submit. Fulfillment remains provider-confirmed webhook and payment-status authority.
